Route the most recent hemoglobin result to the clinic of whoever saw this patient at their last follow-up visit; what was it, and is it low?
Context: patient MRN SYN-e4531b2f27 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2020-07-14, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order.
